notes: The neutral description identifies the Hawaii vacation/exam scenario (PAYING TO KNOW, printed pp. 305–306), whereas the supplied p. 2/Table 1 locator identifies the separate gamble experiment (N = 98), not this outcome. The Hawaii section prints choice percentages, but no named effect size, inferential statistic, or p value for these choices. No Cramer's V was calculated from rounded percentages. The description names both postponement and purchasing without identifying a critical contrast or omnibus test. Candidate sample information only: 66 disjunctive participants, 67 Pass participants, and 67 Fail participants are explicitly different groups; 66 + 67 + 67 = 200 participants across the three descriptive conditions. This is not entered as the critical-test analytic N because the target comparison is unspecified. A separate additional N = 123 within-subject Pass/Fail sample on p. 306 must not be added to those groups. No exclusions are specified for the Hawaii groups. The requested field-level absence findings concern the described Hawaii outcome; overall target_match remains null because exact test correspondence is unresolved. PDF pages 1–2 were rendered and visually checked; all evidence quotes cite the supplied canonical text. Unassigned replication and success fields are placeholders only. Source version note retained: scanned published article from licensed EBSCO; last-page metadata discrepancy explicitly retained by the supplied input; no source-version substitution made.
